lines.t: No longer bind yourself to what you see
Rise above the world, dark mystery
He is who He is, the truth that sets you free
In every moment, He is here
Gather up, beloved, in the knowing light
Death is conquered, darkness turns to light
Fly on wings of faith, no fear, no retreat
In the volumes of truth, our souls meet
Once lost and naked, now clothed in white
From hunger and thirst to endless light
Living bread and water, eternal delight
Eat, drink, be filled in this holy rite
Gather up, beloved, in the knowing light
Death is conquered, darkness turns to light
Fly on wings of faith, no fear, no retreat
In the volumes of truth our souls meet
Peace resides in the knowing he is he
Though sorrows descend, in faith we'll be free
No matter the season, in storms or in calm seas
Hold fast the truth and find your peace
Gather up, beloved, in the knowing light
Death is conquered, darkness turns to light
Fly on wings of faith, no fear, no retreat
In the volumes of truth, our souls are made
How long will you wait? The time is now
Surrender your life and take your vow
Believe and know, let your spirit avow
He is who He is forever and now
